1.why: Boost.cpp:57 reads rightConnected from this jack; while it is empty Boost.cpp:69-74 send the left input through the same gain and clipper to the right output, and while it is patched Boost.cpp:82-88 use this jack instead

0.why: Boost.cpp:66 clamp(boosted, -5, 5) before the volume knob scales it down

comment: In the 1x position the gain is the knob value alone (Boost.cpp:44), so the knob attenuates rather than boosts there; in the other two positions it is 1 + knob * (multiplier - 1). The clipping lamp is driven only from the right channel's value (Boost.cpp:92), which the manual does not say.
